EOMN : HRPQ ∷ YTRS : ?
solution:
The first, second, third, and fourth letters of the first group are moved three steps forward respectively to obtain the corresponding letters of the second group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9efe30b69c72dfad92150e4384d35a68c986a1da08d67e7857f316daeca45223.png] 

YTRS will associate with BWUV.

Hence, **Option (3)** is correct.
